method.gold_join: after source-blind prediction and sham prediction SHA frozen
method.main: fraction of native RGB pixels whose max-channel abs difference from matched right reference >=24; flag if >0.0005
method.negative_control: shuffled other-activity CLEAN reference, exact same native orientation dimensions and pixel calculation; abstain if not available
method.same_input_same_cost_baseline: global mean RGB absolute delta >1.5 on exact same decoded image/reference arrays

paired_same_positive_global_vs_localized.caution: posthoc paired description with app correlated cases; not a preregistered model selection or extrapolation

scientific_limits: Controls are EXACT clean reference bytes, so zero false positives is a construction shortcut and not robust to legitimate changing native application content
Sources include 39 Android apps for 100 cases; samples are correlated, so independent-binomial confidence is illustrative only
Authors synthetic mutation label is not independent human judgment of actual visually objectionable clipping/overlap
An exact approved screenshot mismatch is a narrow source-defined property only, not sufficient to auto-reject semantic rendering flaws in dynamic screens
The source alignment method has extra clean reference input; sham controls isolate reference identity but cannot substitute for a same-input generic image-only model
No actual new owner render/audio/video, no natural frame-level fault timing gold, no certified engineering machine reference, no live SWAAG hook or production GPU inference evaluated
selection: Externally released test split only, hash ranked 25 clip +25 overlap +50 right; image extraction before author-label join; names encode classes but prediction functions never inspect class names.
source_gold_scope: Author manually curated original right Android screens then independently injected synthetic clipping and overlap mutations. These are not new human-adjudicated screenshots or production user-visible severity labels.
